Engine: rsync --delete; rsync may be absent, so a cp -a fallback must converge, recursively and on both sync paths, to the identical end state — a contents-of-source sync (src/->dst), no nesting (A4). One-way, host->workspace, no write-back (A2).

**Deliverables**
One artifact dir: sync-hermes-context.sh, hermes-context.service, hermes-context.timer, README.md. Scheduling: systemd user units, no root required — a systemctl --user timer firing every 6 hours via OnCalendar, ExecStart runs the script (A3). Handoff: the next seat receives state S_1 (S_0 plus this packet's delta) with a report of work done (+done), answers locked (-resolved), open items (+open), and validation (+validation). Remaining ambiguities (Q17): OPEN.
